description:
Create a custom area rug in the living room of the sample house. 

Goal: Draw a rectangular rug in the center of the living room using the floor editing tools. The rug must be a distinct carpet/fabric texture overlaying the existing floor, leaving a visible border of the original flooring around the edges (not wall-to-wall).

Steps:
1. Ensure the default Sample House project is loaded.
2. Navigate to the Living Room.
3. Use the Building > Floor tools (e.g., 'Draw Path' or 'Floor Rect') to create a new floor section in the center of the room.
4. Apply a Carpet texture to this new section.
5. Verify in 3D view that the rug is visible with the original floor showing around it.
6. Save a screenshot of the 3D view to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\rug_design.png'.
